title: Nourishing Shattering Vietnamese Wild Mushrooms Com Tam
description: Savory Vietnamese dish featuring wild mushrooms and a festive ssam-wrap style, perfect for a Buddhist temple gathering. This dish is a delicious and nourishing option for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: wild mushrooms
ingredients.notes: such as shiitake or oyster mushrooms

instructions: Cook the com tam rice according to package instructions and let it cool.
Marinate the tofu in a mixture of soy sauce and maple syrup, then bake it in the oven until golden brown.
Slice the pickled carrots and cucumber into thin strips.
Chop the mint leaves and set them aside for garnish.
Heat the peanut sauce in a saucepan over low heat until warmed through.
Assemble the dish by placing a scoop of com tam rice onto a plate, followed by a few slices of tofu, some pickled carrots and cucumber, and a sprinkle of mint leaves.
Drizzle the peanut sauce over the top of the dish and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
Serve the dish immediately and enjoy.
Offer the dish as a ssam-wrap style, allowing each guest to assemble their own wrap with the various ingredients.
